override.hint: Koyaushe ana shigar da sokewar tare da asalin admin ɗin ku da dalili - kar a yi shiru.

detail.disputeOpen: Ana buɗe takaddamar mallakar mallakar wannan abokin ciniki - wani abokin tarayya ya ce nasu ne. An yanke shawara akan shafin jayayya.

cancellation.title: An soke yin rajista
cancellation.hint: An soke yin rajistar da hukumarsa; ikon mallakar aiki ya dawo tare da abokin aikin kuma magini na iya sake yin ajiyar wannan jagorar.

disputes.title: Rigingimun Mallaka
disputes.hint: Abokin haɗin gwiwa wanda aka ƙi rajistarsa ​​azaman kwafi zai iya jayayya wanda ya mallaki abokin ciniki. Yi bitar bangarorin biyu kuma ku yanke shawara.
